K=6532d6454b8aa370768e63d6ba5a832e; for s in IODESA137 IODESA138 IODESA139 IODESS41 IODESS44 IODESS16 IODESS31 IODESS37 IKRASN91; do curl -s "https://api.weather.com/v2/pws/observations/current?stationId=$s&format=json&units=m&apiKey=$K" | python3 -c "
import sys,json
try:
    o=json.load(sys.stdin)[\"observations\"][0]; print(\"$s\", o.get(\"lat\"), o.get(\"lon\"), o.get(\"neighborhood\"), o.get(\"country\"))
except Exception as e: print(\"$s ERR\", e)"; done; echo COORD_DONE
